title: Frontend: Slugify a String
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Slugify a String. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Derive a lowercase ASCII slug: trim, lowercase, replace every run of non-a-z/non-0-9 characters with one hyphen, remove outside hyphens. This bounded contract does not transliterate Unicode or ensure uniqueness. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Title. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Choose Unicode preservation or transliteration deliberately.
alternativeApproaches: Add reserved-word checks and server-side uniqueness without changing existing public URLs silently.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Punctuation-only title; accents; repeated separators.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
